name: ycf-workspace
description: Open-source codebase audit, cleanup, refactoring and verification engine.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @ycf/core build && corepack pnpm --filter your-code-is-fucked build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @ycf/core typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @ycf/core build && corepack pnpm --filter your-code-is-fucked typecheck
scripts.pack:check: corepack pnpm --filter @ycf/core exec npm pack --dry-run && corepack pnpm --filter your-code-is-fucked exec npm pack --dry-run
